merge_tfrecords: merge multiple TFRecord input files into a single output TFRecord file
duplicate_tfrecord_examples: duplicate TFRecord examples by specifying per-input multipliers
flatten_tfrecord_pcollections: flatten multiple Apache Beam PCollections of TFRecord examples into one
run_tfrecord_merge_pipeline: run the TFRecord merge pipeline with input and output file paths
validate_multipliers_count: validate that the number of multipliers matches the number of input files
